sentences.en: Marriage! Nothing else demands so much from a man!
sentences.vi: Hôn nhân! Không có gì khác đòi hỏi quá nhiều từ một người đàn ông!

sentences.en: He breezed in and demanded tea.

sentences.en: The authorities proved unyielding on one crucial opposition demand.

sentences.en: I have many demands on my time.

sentences.en: They are demanding the release of all political prisoners.
